Observed data and model estimates

Source: R/stockpile_values.R
stockpile_values.Rd

Get the values for one or more stock assessments: catches, weights, maturity, natural mortality, stock numbers and fishing mortality, by age and year. By default the latest version of each stock assessment is returned.

Usage

stockpile_values(
  stock_code = NULL,
  assessment_year = NULL,
  version = "latest",
  as_of = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  slot = NULL,
  url = stockpile_url(),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

stock_code

stock codes, for example "sol.27.7d". The default is all stocks.

assessment_year

assessment years. The default is all years.

version

"latest" for the most recent version of each stock assessment, "all" for every version, or version numbers.

as_of

a date or time, to see the dataset as it stood then: only versions submitted up to that time are used. A date means the start of that day.

type

"observed" or "estimated". The default is all values.

slot

the slots to return, named as in an FLStock, for example "catch.n". The default is all slots.

url

the location of the dataset, see stockpile_url().

refresh

read the table again, even if it has already been read in this session.

Value

A data frame with one row per value:

stock_code, assessment_year, version

identify the version

slot

the slot, named as in an FLStock

type

"observed", "estimated" or "both"

age

the age, or NA for a total over ages

year, unit, season, area

the year, and the unit, season and area as named by the submitter

value

the value. Missing values are not stored

units

the units of measurement given by the submitter

Details

A value is stored as "observed" or "estimated". Where a slot is the same in the observed and the estimated object, for example the maturity, it is stored once with type "both". Asking for type = "observed" or type = "estimated" returns the values of that type together with those of type "both", which is everything in the submitted object of that type.

Where the submitted object had iterations, the values are the medians over the iterations.

See also

stockpile_flstock() to get the values as an FLStock.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
stockpile_values("sol.27.7d", slot = "catch")
stockpile_values("sol.27.7d", type = "observed", slot = "catch.n")
} # }
